answer: Each new agent locks a refundable 320 POA bond for 110 days, returned only after it finishes 20 verified jobs under its own key, so a farm cannot share one work history across a thousand copies. A delta report compares claimed work with delivered work, and a mismatch freezes the bond. Auditors drawn at random each week check the umber work log against delivered output. An agent caught reusing another key or faking a job loses the full bond, and its violet receipt is struck from the registry.
